ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply; see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. Enrollment in this course section is restricted to undergraduate degree and nondegree students. Undergrad students enrolling in this section must also register in the summer QMUE Conference being held on the Urbana campus from May 23 to 26. There is a separate registration charge for the conference participation. Conference information and registration charges can be seen at: http://qmue.music.illinois.edu
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: Graduate - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $309.00 per Bill Hour, Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $277.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $45.00 per Bill Hour.
